# healthchecksio_ping_body (Data Source)

The logged request body of one ping. This data source needs a read-write API key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "healthchecksio_ping_body" "last" {
  check_id = healthchecksio_check.backup.id
  n        = data.healthchecksio_pings.backup.pings[0].n
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `check_id` (String) The check: its unique_key (the `id` of `healthchecksio_check`) or its UUID.
- `n` (Number) The number of the ping, from `healthchecksio_pings`.

### Read-Only

- `body` (String, Sensitive) The body, as text. Null when the body is not valid UTF-8. A body can contain secrets. Thus, it is sensitive.
- `body_base64` (String, Sensitive) The body, base64-encoded. Use it for a binary body.
